Commentary.Commentary: We're back and so are the players on the ground. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das are the openers for Bangladesh. Needless to say, the start is going to be the key for both teams, more so for Afghanistan. They need early wickets to stay in the hunt. Fazalhaq Farooqi, sporting a black headband, is ready to bowl the first over. Two slips in place. Here we go...
... LET'S CHASE ...

Right, then. The average first inning score on this ground is around 255 runs in the last few matches and the hosts have done well to restrict Afghanistan to just 215 runs. They will surely back themselves to chase it down with ease. That said, Afghanistan also have a potent spin attack, capable of taking down any batting line-up. Who will take the lead in this ODI series? To find out, do join us for the second essay in a short while.

Mehidy Hasan (10-3-28-0) comes up for a quick word. The offie says that 215 is a good score to restrict Afghanistan. Shares that the wicket is good and if they bat well, they will chase it down. Adds that he just tried to bowl the dot balls in the middle overs and create pressure. Feels that they need to play their normal cricket and they are confident to chase down the target.

The Bangla bowlers were on song with the ball from the word go. For just a brief moment when the fifth wicket stand was brewing, they were under a bit of pressure but Taskin Ahmed removed Mohammad Nabi and handed the advantage back to the home team. The pacers did well to apply the pressure in the opening overs and later the spinners continued the good work. Bangladesh would’ve loved to bundle out Afghanistan inside 200 but they would surely take 215 with open arms. Mustafizur Rahman was the pick of the bowlers with three wickets and the others also impressed with their disciplined contribution.

Afghanistan will be disappointed with their effort with the bat. Najibullah Zadran fought a lone battle for them and made sure to take the score above the 200-run mark. They looked to be in trouble right from the start after losing Rahmanullah Gurbaz in the third over itself. Even though they did not lose any more wickets in Powerplay 1, they were kept in check throughout and were never allowed to score runs freely. The same continued for the next 15 overs, as Afghanistan only managed to score 45 runs and lost two wickets as well. Post the 25-over mark, the Afghan batters started to free their arms and got going. The stand for the fifth wicket between Najibullah Zadran and Mohammad Nabi was the biggest one as they added 63 runs in quick time, only if this stand would’ve grown, things could have been different for the visitors.

A disciplined bowling show from Bangladesh! They were on the money right from the beginning and kept suffocating Afghanistan throughout the innings. It appeared to be a good wicket for batting but perhaps, Afghanistan's overcautious approach made them struggle more than anything.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mustafizur Rahman delivers it full and in the line of the leg stump, Yamin Ahmadzai steps back to make room and tries to play an inside-out shot through the line. The connection though is not quite there and the ball balloons towards extra cover. Mahmudullah runs back a bit from inside the ring, perhaps misjudges it slightly but eventually does well to catch it over his head as he tumbles down. Afghanistan are all out for 215!
Fuller and around off, driven down to long off for a single.
Swing and a miss! The batter swings hard at that one but does not connect.
Fazalhaq Farooqi is the last man in.

OUT! Zadran holes out! Clever deception from Shoriful Islam. Bowls it slower through the air and lands it in the half for the batter, Najibullah Zadran decides to go downtown with full force but has no pace to work with. Fails to generate his own power and it ends up being a tame aerial shot to long on. Mahmudullah takes an easy catch in the deep. End of a painstaking knock from Zadran but he at least put up a fight.
Shortish and outside off, Yamin Ahmadzai pushes it out in the gap at covers for one.
Fuller and slower around off at 110.4 kph, once again Zadran drags it over mid-wicket. Only a run on this occasion.

NOT OUT! Fractionally short and around off, angling in, Zadran hangs on the back foot and drags his attempted pull shot down to long on. He attempts for the second run, the throw from the deep comes to the keeper who takes the bails off. Not much excitement is shown by Rahim but still, there is an appeal. The square leg umpire takes it upstairs. The third umpire watches a few angles and decides that Zadran is safe.
Is that a run out? The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The replays show the batter has his blade inside the crease. Zadran is safe as the big screen shows NOT OUT.
Slower this time, full and dipping around off at 114 kph, Yamin Ahmadzai keeps it out to covers.
Play and a miss! Mustafizur Rahman clocks 139.3 kph and serves it full and wide outside off, Yamin Ahmadzai is beaten for pace as he tries to drive.
Shortish and on off, Zadran plays a mistimed shot down to long off for a run.
Pace up from the bowler this time, around off on a length, Zadran tries to punch but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
SIX! Nailed! What a shot from Zadran. Slower one again at 98 kph, on the shorter side around off, Najibullah Zadran clears his front leg and powers it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
A dipping yorker around off, at 113 kph, Yamin Ahmadzai digs it out and it goes past the bowler to mid off. They cross.
Slower and fuller outside off, at 104.6 kph, Zadran lofts it over extra cover and it's a late call from him to take the second run.
Full and outside off, Yamin drives it square of the wicket on the off side and picks up a single. 200 comes up!
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side, Yamin Ahmadzai tries flicking but misses. Mushfiqur Rahim does well to stop it.
Slower one, full and around leg at 109 kph, Najibullah Zadran tries heaving it over the leg side but scuffs it down to long on for one.
A touch short and around off, Najibullah Zadran is on the back foot and he defends it to covers. A single available there but not taken.
Lands it on a length around off, angling away, Yamin Ahmadzai tries to drive but edges it down to third man. A single.
A low full toss on middle, Zadran knocks it down to long on and picks up a single, strangely. He should be looking to farm the strike now.
Switches to 'round the wicket and hurls across a short ball outside off, Yamin leaves it alone.
Yamin Ahmadzai is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Identical to the last delivery and this time the leading edge has flown in the air. Fuller and around middle, at 114.9 kph, Mujeeb closes the face of the bat very early in his attempt to flick and hands a simple catch to Najmul Hossain Shanto (sub) at covers. Afghanistan are not finishing strongly here.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Najmul Hossain Shanto b Mustafizur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: Slower one, a cutter around off at 111 kph, Mujeeb tries to flick but gets a leading edge. It though goes safely to covers.
Angling away from the batter, outside off, Mujeeb pushes inside the line and misses.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it to the off side.
Back of a length, around off, Najibullah Zadran goes back and pulls it in front of square leg for a single.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is the next batter. Also, Mustafizur Rahman returns to operate at the death.

OUT! TIMBER! Shakib Al Hasan picks up his second wicket of the over and a smile breaks out on his face. Flatter and around off, a touch short and skidding on with the angle at 87.8 kph, Rashid stays inside the crease and looks to punch it away but misses. The ball sneaks through the gap and uproots the off stump. Afghanistan slip further.
Full and on off. Khan defends it out watchfully.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Rashid Khan walks in next. Afghanistan need some fireworks from his bat.

OUT! LBW! The umpire raises his dreaded finger. This is brilliant bowling by Shakib Al Hasan. An arm ball, angled in from outside off. Gulbadin Naib leans in and tries to defend it out but misses to get hit on the pads. Shakib Al Hasan appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Naib takes the review and the UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows three reds and Naib continues his walk to the pavilion.
It's floated, full and on leg. Naib defends it out solidly.
On the pads, Zadran clips it to mid-wicket for one run.
Full and wide outside off, whacked down to long off for just a single.

Shout for an lbw! Not entertained and Tamim has decided to review it. A full-length ball, angled into the pads. Zadran looks to flick it away but gets pinged on the pads. Shoriful Islam pleads but the umpire shakes his head. The review is taken much in hope. To the naked eye, it looked like it was going down leg and the Ball Tracking confirms the same. Najibullah Zadran stays in the middle and Bangladesh lose a review this time.
Back of a length, on off, Naib pushes it towards point for a single.
Full length, outside off. Naib throws the kitchen sink at it but fails to get any blade on it.
A length ball, on the pads. Naib stays back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple now.
Full length, on the stumps. Naib defends it towards mid off.
Change in bowling after Taskin Ahmed has completed his quota. Shoriful Islam is back on.
Tossed up, on off. Naib eases it to long on for a single. Shakib not giving anything away!
A responsible knock by Zadran. He gets his FIFTY now. A much-needed knock for his side. Around leg, Zadran clips it to square leg for one.
Tossed up, on leg. Naib clips it towards mid on for a single.
Slower through the air, on the stumps. Naib defends it out watchfully.
Around middle and leg. Zadran tucks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Angled in, full and on leg. Zadran stays back and flicks it to long on for a brace.
Good length, outside off. Zadran stands tall and punches it through cover-point for a single. 10 runs off the over.
Full length, on the pads. Naib clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
A slower one, full and down leg. Zadran clips it to short fine leg but straight to the fielder. They take one.
Back of a length, on off. Zadran defends it back to Taskin Ahmed.
A length ball, on off. Naib gets it to the leg side off the inner half. The batters cross for a single.
SIX! ALL THE WAY! Gulbadin Naib using all his strength on this one. Overpitched, on off, Naib gets underneath it and muscles it over the long on fence. Biggie.
Taskin Ahmed is back into the attack to bowl his final over.
Quicker, full and on the stumps. Zadran pushes it to the left of the bowler. A tidy over by Shakib Al Hasan.
Flatter and on leg. Naib tucks it to short fine leg for a single.
Full and on the pads, Zadran clips it to mid-wicket and gets a single.
On the stumps, fuller, Zadran blocks it back to the bowler.
Really good running between the wickets. Full and on off, Naib defends it to covers for a quick single.
WIDE! Tossed up, full and angled down leg. Naib looks to flick it but misses. Wide called.
Flatter and angled down leg, Najibullah Zadran nudges it to square leg for one.
End of Powerplay 2! That means now 5 fielders will be allowed to be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the innings. Shakib Al Hasan is back on.
Slower one to deceive the batter, full and around middle, it's defended back.
Superb fielding. Back of a length, around off, Najibullah Zadran goes back and smacks it down to mid off. The fielder there dives across to his left and saves a certain boundary. Only one taken.

Shout for an lbw! Pace up from Mustafizur Rahman as he spears in a full ball around leg at 139 kph. Najibullah Zadran tries to flick but misses. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Missing leg.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it gently to mid off for a brisk single.
Fuller and outside off, at 135.9 kph, Naib times his drive perfectly but finds the cover fielder inside the ring.
Around off, on a length, Gulbadin Naib goes on the back foot and plays it down to point.
Shortish and around off, Naib goes back and plays late. He guides it down to third man and takes a single to open his account.
Once again Gulbadin Naib is forward to a length ball but his drive finds the fielder on the off side.
Around off, on a length, pushed to covers.
Gulbadin Naib is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Again, you have to credit Tamim Iqbal for this bowling change. A very dangerous partnership has been broken and Taskin Ahmed is all smiles. This is a beautiful outswinger from him, he lands it close to off and gets it to nip away a shade. Mohammad Nabi tries driving through the line but the away movement results in an outside edge and Mushfiqur Rahim dives across to his right to complete the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mushfiqur Rahim b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Play and a miss! Short in length and outside off, Nabi tries to cut it away but misses.

FOUR! That's a classic drive! Taskin delivers it full and wide outside off, Nabi strides forward and times his cover drive through the gap for a boundary. Afghanistan have some momentum going ahead of the death overs.
Taskin Ahmed (8-0-40-1) is back into the attack.
Fuller and around off, from 'round the wicket, Nabi pushes it with gentle hands to mid on for a single.
Taps a length ball down to point and picks up a single after scoring a boundary.

FOUR! Well played! Fuller in length, around off and angling in at 133.4 kph, Zadran knows that mid on is up and takes a calculative risk. He lofts it with a straight bat, clears the infield and finds the fence.
Shortish and on off, Zadran goes on his back foot and pushes it to covers.

Four leg byes! Speedy delivery, full and drifting down the leg side, Zadran fails to flick and it races away off his pads to the fine leg fence. The 50-run stand comes up and it has come in good time. It's paramount for Afghanistan that this pair bats the distance.
In the channel outside off, Zadran is on the back foot as he chops it down to point.
Fuller and on middle, Najibullah bunts it down towards mid on and scampers across to the other end.
Fuller and on the pads, at 137.4 kph, Nabi eases it behind square leg for a run. 150 up for Afghanistan.
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side, Nabi tries flicking but misses.
Shout for an lbw! Not given. Back of a length, around leg and straightening off the surface, Nabi tries to glance but misses. He is hit on the front pad, they appeal but the umpire shakes his head.

Fractionally short and close to off, angling in, Zadran plays it down to point. Nabi wants a run but is sent back as Liton scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. The ball deflects and would have raced away had Mehidy not intercepted with his right hand. He takes the pace off the ball and it's only one run as an overthrow.
Angling in from around off, Zadran closes the face of his bat and works it to mid-wicket.
Slower one, on a length close to off, Zadrab taps it down to covers and looks for a run but Nabi sends him back.
Wide! On a length and wide outside off, Zadran swishes and misses.
Mustafizur Rahman (5-0-19-1) is back into the attack now.
FOUR! A boundary on the final ball spoils a good over. Short in length, around middle and off, Nabi swivels on the back foot and pulls it behind square leg for a boundary.
Aerial but safe! Short in length and outside off, Najibullah Zadran stays back to ramp it down but it takes the top edge and flies down to third man but falls safely. A single is taken.
Fuller around leg, at 134 clicks, Nabi clips it behind square leg and picks up a single.
Three dots now, pressure building. A touch short and close to off, Nabi pushes it from the back foot to covers.
Another dot. Around off, on a good length, it's defended back to the bowler off the inner half.
Starts his new spell with a short ball outside off, Nabi cuts from the back foot but finds the point fielder.

Drinks break. 140/4 with 15 overs left. Another 100 runs from here will put Afghanistan into a position from where they can fight with their spinners. That seems to be the plan. Najibullah Zadran and Mohammad Nabi are in the middle, both known for striking big and those to follow can also tonk the ball long. Can they finish the innings well? Shoriful Islam to operate after the break. 5-1-10-1 are his figures thus far.
9 runs off the over. A good one for Afghanistan. Tossed up, full and on off. Nabi works it towards long on for a single.
Full, on middle and leg. Zadran stays back and clips it to deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! Angled down the leg side. Zadran gets low and tries to sweep but misses. Wide called.
FOUR! Down the ground! Flighted, full and on off. Zadran makes room and drills it to long off for a boundary.
On the pads, Nabi flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on the stumps. Nabi defends it back to the bowler.
Full, on middle and leg. Nabi eases it to mid on. A dot now.
WIDE! Slower through the air, angled down leg, Nabi tries to flick it away but misses. Wided.
Shakib Al Hasan has a change of ends.
Back of a length, outside off. Zadran looks to cut it away but does not middle it. He is clearly frustrated as he could not get it into the gap. 5 runs off the over.
Good length, around off, much straighter. Zadran hangs back and cuts it hard towards backward point. The fielder gets low to his right and makes a sharp stop.
Length ball, on the stumps. Najibullah Zadran blocks it out watchfully.
FOUR! Easy pickings! A full-length ball, angling down leg. Najibullah Zadran stays back and glances it down to fine leg for a boundary. Some reverse swing for the Fizz but the line was not accurate.
A length ball, on off. Zadran defends it out.
Fuller, outside off. Nabi drives it towards mid on for one run.

Nine per over from this stage will take Afghanistan to 279. They will be targeting that for now. Tamim Iqbal has made another bowling change - Mustafizur Rahman is back on. 1/14 in his 4 overs so far.
Full, on off. Zadran presses forward and defends it out. Mehidy Hasan is done with his economical spell of 10 overs. No wicket for him but he played his role in keeping everything tight.
Flatter and outside off. Nabi cuts it to point for a single.
Touch short and on off. Zadran cuts it aerially to sweeper cover. They take a single.
Finds the fielder. Short in length and outside off, Najibullah Zadran goes back to cut but finds the fielder at point.
Quicker and fuller on off, pushed back to the bowler again.
Tossed up, full and around off, defended back.
Full, outside off. Zadran pushes it towards mid off for a single.
Full and outside off. Zadran hangs his blade out and gets it to the cover region off the outer half.
Fuller, on middle. Nabi flicks it to long on for an easy single. The pair is making sure to keep the runs ticking.
On middle and leg. Zadran flicks it through mid-wicket for one run.
SIX! This time some width on offer and Zadran makes the most of it. Fuller, outside off. Najibullah Zadran gets under it and smokes it over the long off fence. Maximum.
On off, Zadran defends it out to safety.
This is the 122nd dot delivery of the innings. Tossed up, full and on off, blocked out watchfully.
Full, on off. Zadran drives it to covers and gets a single.
Flatter and on off. Zadran outside-edges his attempted square cut to short third man. Luckily for him, it lands short of the man there.
Touch short and on off. Zadran chops it to cover.
Tossed up, on off. Zadran leans in and defends solidly.
Looped up, full, on off. Nabi works it to mid on for one.
FOUR! Zadran takes the risk and gets rewarded. Floated, full and on off. Najibullah Zadran gets low and reverse-sweeps it through point for a boundary.
Full and on the stumps. Zadran blocks it out to safety.
Full and outside off, Zadran gets it to the off side off the outer half.

Flighted and around off, Mohammad Nabi drives it back towards the bowler. Shakib Al Hasan moves across to his left a bit too much and the ball scoots past his right hand to long off. They cross for a single.
A single as this is eased down to long on.
Floated, full and outside off. Nabi drives it through covers for a single.
Mahmudullah did his job and Tamim Iqbal brings his strike bowler, Shakib Al Hasan, back into the attack. Tamim has been very proactive with his captaincy so far, reading the game superbly.
Quicker, full, on off. Zadran blocks it out watchfully.
Full and on off. Najibullah Zadran drives it through the cover region for a couple of runs this time.
Almost finds the edge! Tossed up, outside off, it turns away after hitting the deck. Najibullah Zadran is drawn forward, as he looks to defend it out - only to get beaten on the outside edge.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Nabi comes forward and clips it through mid on for a single.
Full and on the stumps. Nabi blocks it out solidly.
Fullish and around off, it's driven down to long off for a single.
Mohammad Nabi to bat at number 6.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mahmudullah does the trick with his off spin. He gets a wicket in his very first over. A top decision by the skipper. It is tossed up, outside off and a bit on the shorter side, Hashmatullah Shahidi stays inside the crease and looks to cut it to the off side. The ball though takes the toe end of his bat and Mushfiqur Rahim grabs the ball sharply behind the sticks. Mahmudullah appeals and the umpire raises his dreaded finger. The Afghanistan skipper trudges back to the pavilion.
A single as this is worked towards mid off.
Tossed up, full and on leg, Hashmatullah Shahidi sweeps it through square leg for a single.
On off, Shahidi defends it back to the bowler.
Quicker and fuller, on off. Zadran goes back and helps it down the ground to long off for one more. 100 up for Afghanistan in the 28th over.
Flighted, full and on off. Shahidi leans in and works it to long on for one.
Mahmudullah is introduced into the attack. A strategical move from Tamim Iqbal with two lefties at the crease.
Touch short, outside off. Zadran punches it to cover. Three dots on the trot to end the over.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Zadran defends it back to the bowler again.
Angled in, full on middle and leg. Zadran plays it back to the bowler.
Around off. Shahidi eases it to covers for an easy single.
SIX! The skipper takes the charge. Floated, full and on off. Hashmatullah Shahidi gets low and slog-sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Tossed up, on off. Zadran pushes it to covers for one.
Slightly short and outside off. Zadran slaps it through covers. There is a man in the deep and they take one. Only 4 runs off the over.
A length ball, on off. Zadran pushes it out.
A short ball, on middle. Shahidi shuffles across and almost cramps himself up for room. Tucks it to square leg for one.
Back of a length, outside off. Shahidi stands inside the crease and looks to heave it across the line but misses. Two dots in a row.
Full length, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi shuffles across and pushes it to covers with gentle hands. A dot now.
Back of a length, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi stands tall and cuts it through covers for a brace.
Full and wide outside off, Zadran drives but Tamim Iqbal stops it with a dive at covers. Maiden!
Quicker and fuller on middle, defended down on the deck.
Najibullah Zadran tries to be adventurous! Loopy and around off, Zadran tries to play the reverse-batted shot but misses. It pings him on the gloves and dies down on the pitch.
Fuller and around off, slower in pace, Zadran defends off the front foot.
Flatter and around off, Zadran stays back and plays it down to point.
Quicker and fuller on off, defended back.
Angles in a length ball on off, at 136.6 kph, Shahidi keeps his weight on the back foot and defends it on the leg side.
Hurls in a length ball around off, Shahidi defends it watchfully from the crease.
Around off, on a length, Shahidi plays from the back foot to point.

FOUR! Streaky! The slip was removed and Hashmatullah Shahidi survives. On a length and outside off, Shahidi pushes inside the line and edges it through the vacant slip region for a boundary. Now, the slip comes in again.
Width there outside off, Shahidi tries to attack from the back foot but misses.
Serves it on a full length and outside off, Najibullah Zadran scuffs his drive to mid-wicket off the inner half for a single.
A slider again, around off, Hashmatullah Shahidi tries to defend but it perhaps takes the inner edge and strikes him on the pads. If no bat, he would have been plumb in front.
Short and outside off, Zadran goes back and cuts it through point for one.
Fuller and on off, driven back to the bowler.
A slider around off, Najibullah Zadran defends it from the inner half of his bat.
Fuller and off, defended back.
Gets on the front foot and pushes a full ball to point for a single.
Najibullah Zadran is the new batter. He has an ODI strike rate of 90, something Afghanistan need at this stage.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Taskin's hard work pays off! The speedster runs in and delivers it on a shortish length around off, at 136 kph. Rahmat Shah is on his toes as he tries to play it square of the wicket on the off side. But there is some extra bounce on the delivery and it shoots up to kiss the shoulder of his blade. Mushfiqur Rahim takes a simple catch and Afghanistan lose their third wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Mushfiqur Rahim b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Short in length around off, at 136.7 kph, Hashmatullah Shahidi goes on the back foot and pulls it behind square leg for a single.
Taskin Ahmed goes short and delivers it around off at 136 clicks, Hashmatullah Shahidi leans back and evades it.
On a good length, close to off at 134.1 kph, Rahmat punches it in front of square on the off side and picks up a single.
Another delivery in the channel outside off, Shahidi runs it down to third man and rotates the strike.
Back of a length outside off, Shah guides it down to third man for a single.
Full and around off, a slider, Shahidi leans forward and defends it from the inner half of his blade.
Flatter and shorter on off, Hashmatullah Shahidi goes back and strokes it to the cover fielder.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it to covers.
Around leg, nudged to short fine leg.

Beaten in flight! Loopy delivery around off, spinning in, Rahmat walks down the track but is beaten in the flight. He misses but has his pads behind as the second line of defense. It clips his pads and deflects wide of the keeper. They steal a leg bye.
Flatter off spinner, around off and staying low, Shah does well to keep it out safely.
Fuller and around middle and off, at 138.1 kph, Shahidi sticks on the back foot and blocks it to the off side.
On a length around middle, at 137 kph, Shahidi defends it down on the leg side.
Pitches it up and around off at 132.3 kph, Shah slices his attempted drive through backward point for a single.
Serves it on a length and outside off, Shah drives but finds the cover fielder.
Beaten again! Just a hint of movement, outside off on a length, Rahmat hangs his bat out tamely and is beaten.
Beaten! Delivers it on a length and just outside off, it holds its line after landing, Shah pushes at it and misses.
Change in bowling. Taskin Ahmed is back on. 0/26 in his 4 overs so far.
Loopy and full, close to off, Shahidi draws forward in defense.
FOUR! Better from Shahidi! Flatter and shorter around off, Hashmatullah Shahidi hangs on the back foot, waits for a while and then cuts it wide of backward point.
Full and around leg, worked behind square leg for a single.

Just away from Mushfiqur Rahim. Loopy and full, around off, Rahmat goes for the paddle sweep and Mushfiqur Rahim anticipates it. He moves across to his left, stretches his arms but it goes wide to fine leg. Two runs.
Full again, pushed back to the bowler who dived and parried it to mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, Rahmat walks forward and flicks it off the inner half to square leg.
Short and around off at 139 kph, Rahmat swivels and pulls it to square leg for one.
Shortish and on off, dabbed down to third man for a run.
EDGY FOUR! And... Hashmatullah Shahidi opens his account on the 14th ball. Full and wide outside off, he flashes his blade at it and edges it wide of the slip fielder for a boundary at third man.
Back of a length, around off, Shahidi defends it from the back foot to backward point.
Short and on middle, pulled through square leg for a single.
Angling away from the right-hander, on a good length, Rahmat allows it through to the keeper.
Quicker one, full and around leg, Shahidi fails to defend and is hit on the pads. They appeal but for nothing. 12 balls for the Afghan skipper without any run.
A slider from 'round the wicket, full and around off, Shahidi lunges to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Flatter and a bit shorter on middle, Shah goes back and turns it in front of square leg for a single.
Walks forward to a full ball and pushes it gently to covers.
A bit of innovation and Rahmat Shah breaks the monotony of dot balls. Full and around middle, Shah paddles it towards fine leg for two.
Full and flighted on off, Rahmat flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length, around off, Shahidi taps it down towards backward point. Another maiden. Not a single run since the fall of the last wicket for Afghanistan.
Play and a miss! Short in length and outside off, at 129 clicks, Hashmatullah Shahidi jumps and tries to cut but it flies over his bat.
Angles it in, around off and on a length, this time the Afghan skipper is forced to use his bat as he blocks.
Action replay of the previous delivery. Shoriful Islam has found a good rhythm at the moment.
On a good length and outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi is content in leaving. Bangladesh have kept one slip for any outside edge.
Hurls it short and wide outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi shoulders arms.

Drinks break. It's been a sedate start from Afghanistan and they are on the back foot after losing two wickets. Rahmat Shah and Hashmatullah Shahidi are at work but they both are known to bat slowly and that might just go against the Afghans in the middle phase. All Bangladesh need to do is to choke the flow of runs and create more pressure.
Short and on off. Shah defends it onto the deck watchfully. Mehidy Hasan starts his spell with a maiden.
Slower one, on middle and leg. Shah nudges it to square leg. No run.
Tossed up, full and on off. Shah uses his feet and defends it back.
Floated, fuller and on the stumps. Shah defends it back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Shah leans in and defends it to covers.
Tossed up, around off, short in length and spinning in a bit. Shah leaves it alone for the keeper.
Change in bowling. Mehidy Hasan replaces Shakib Al Hasan from this end.
A length ball, on off. Shahidi defends it back to the bowler with the full face of the blade. A brilliant over by Islam, a run and a wicket off it.
A length ball, outside off. Shahidi shuffles across and looks to push it away from his body. He gets beaten on the outside edge. This was really close.
Full length, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi shuffles across a long way and blocks it to point.
A length ball, on off, Shahidi defends it out watchfully.
Skipper Hashmatullah Shahidi walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT AT SLIP! Yasir Ali, the debutant, makes no mistake and helps his side to get the breakthrough they were looking for! A length ball, outside off, shaping away a hint. Ibrahim Zadran stays inside the crease and looks to drive it away through the off side. He only manages to get an outside edge which flies towards the only slip fielder. Yasir Ali gets low and pouches the ball safely in the second attempt. Shoriful Islam gets his first wicket of the innings and is all pumped up!
Commentary.Howout: c Yasir Ali b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller in length and outside off, Rahmat opens the face and drives it towards point where Mehidy Hasan fumbles slightly as he dives. They cross for a run as Mehidy recovers but misses his shy at the striker's end. There is a chance for an overthrow but the batters decide against it.
Fuller, on the stumps. Shah drills it to long on for a single.
FOUR! The second one of the over. Rahmat Shah is taking the attack to Shakib Al Hasan. Fuller, on middle and leg. Shah gets down on one knee and powers it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
On off, blocked out solidly.
FOUR! Nicely played. It's floated and angled around leg, Shah gets low and slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket to find the boundary. 50 up!
Angled into the pads. Shah leans in and looks to flick it away. He misses and gets pinged on the pads. Shakib Al Hasan appeals but the umpire is not interested.
Fuller and on the stumps. Shah leans in and blocks it to covers with soft hands.
Three dots in a row to end the over this time. A length ball, on the fourth stump line. Zadran shuffles across and defends it out watchfully.
Another full-length delivery, outside off. Zadran defends it towards cover.
Fuller, outside off, Zadran taps it to point.

DROPPED? Just short of the fielder. Back of a length, outside off. Rahmat Shah hangs back and pulls it to deep square leg off the splice of the bat. It flies over square leg, Shakib Al Hasan picks it up late, he races towards the ball but it lands short as he tries to dive forward. A single taken.
Full length, on off. Shah defends it towards point.
A ripper to start the 12th over. A length ball, outside off, shaping across the right-hander with some extra bounce. Shah looks to have a poke at it but misses.
Three singles on the trot to end the over! Touch short and outside off. Shah works it to sweeper cover for one.
Fuller, and outside off, floated. Ibrahim Zadran punches it to long off for one more.
Full and on off. Shah eases it down to long off for one run. Would be relieved now.
Quicker and flatter, angling down leg. Shah looks to flick it but misses. The ball brushes the pads on its way to the keeper.
Slower through the air, full and on off. Shah blocks it back to the bowler.
Flighted, around middle and leg. Ibrahim Zadran leans in and flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Powerplay 2 time! A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.

Digs it in short, around middle and leg at 133.7 kph, Rahmat goes on his toes and pulls but finds the fielder at square leg. Pressure building on him as he has played a lot of dot balls in succession. At the end of Powerplay 1, Afghanistan are 41/1!
Pitches it up and around off, Rahmat drives through the line and for the umpteenth time he has found the cover fielder in the last 5 minutes.
Around middle, on a length, Zadran works it in the gap at mid-wicket and takes a single.
Lands it on a length and around off, at 137.7 kph, Ibrahim Zadran stays on the back foot and pushes it defensively to mid off. 9 dots in a row!
Clocks 137.5 kph and lands it on a length around middle and off, Ibrahim Zadran defends it from the crease to the off side.
Shortish and around off, angling away at 129.8 kph, Ibrahim Zadran sticks on the back foot and plays it down to point.
Shoriful Islam comes into the attack now.
Loopy and around off, Rahmat Shah walks forward with the drive but again the cover fielder is in his way. Shakib Al Hasan begins his spell with a maiden!
Shakib drags his length short after the batter used his feet on the last ball, it's outside off, Shah cuts but finds the point fielder.
Full and floated on off, Rahmat uses his feet but still finds the fielder at covers after driving it through the line.
Tossed up and around off, Rahmat plays a bit late this time and taps it down to cover-point.
Fuller and around off, Shah drives again but finds the same cover fielder.
A nice loopy ball, full and drifting in on middle, Rahmat drives it to covers.
Change. Shakib Al Hasan comes into the attack now. He replaces Mustafizur Rahman.
Fullish and angling in from around off, Ibrahim Zadran leans across and flicks it in the gap at mid-wicket for two. 15 from the over and this could be the last one in this spell from Taskin Ahmed.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Taskin Ahmed has been awry with his line. Serves a length ball down the leg side, Ibrahim Zadran neatly deflects it off his pads and finds the fence at fine leg.

SIX! That's a shot full of authority! This time Ibrahim gets hold of his pull shot and nails it all the way. Short and around off, Zadran picks up the length very quickly, rides the bounce and pulls it over square leg for a biggie. Afghanistan would hope that this shot will get Ibrahim Zadran going!
Wide! Short and wide outside off, the batsman leaves and the umpire stretches his arms again.
Fuller and around off, a hint of away movement, Rahmat plays close to his body with gentle hands and pushes it off the outer half. The ball races down to third man for a run.
Back of a length, outside off and moving away, Rahmat stays back, drops his wrists and allows it through.
Better this time. Darts a full ball around off, shaping in, Shah defends it back.
Wide! Taskin is getting good movement off the deck but he is not able to control his line consistently. Serves an outswinger quite wide outside off, Rahmat leaves.
Pitches it up and outside off, Rahmat strokes it to the left of mid off and scoots to the other end. It's been a sedate start for Afghanistan.
Attempted slower one, reaching the batsman on the full, Rahmat is over-watchful and fails to make any use of this gift. Bunts it to mid on.
Outside off, angling away, played down to point.

FOUR! Doesn't middle it! Short in length around off, Rahmat is on the back foot and is a bit cramped for room as he checks his shot at the last moment. The ball takes the bottom half and flies over the square leg umpire to find the fence.
Another drive off the front foot from Rahmat but this time it has gone straight to mid off.
Full in length and outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Back of a length, around middle and leg, Rahmat clips it down to fine leg for a single.

PUT DOWN! Taskin Ahmed alters his length and surprises the batsman with a short one. It's bowled at 139 kph and Ibrahim Zadran pulls compulsively at it. He has not timed it too well and the ball goes flying down to deep backward square leg. Mahmudullah is stationed in the deep, he decides to stay back and let the ball arrive. Attempts to take it low but he fails to grab it. Should have come a couple of steps forward. The batsmen cross.
Wide! Taskin delivers an outswinger at 138 clicks but the line is quite wide outside off and the movement takes it further away. Zadran leaves.
Play and a miss! Short in length and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran goes after the width but is beaten again.
Beauty of a delivery! Taskin clocks 137 kph as he delivers it from wide of the crease. On a length and around off, moving away late, Ibrahim Zadran stays back and gets beaten.

Taskin feeds it full and around off, shaping in again, Rahmat tries defending with a loose bottom hand and it takes the inside edge. The ball dribbles through backward square leg and they cross for a single.
Zippy delivery, a touch short and outside off, shaping in a tad, Rahmat covers the line and shoulders arms.
Wide! An attempted bouncer but down the leg side, Rahmat turns inside the crease and allows it through to the keeper.
Full length, on off. Zadran blocks it out solidly. Mustafizur Rahman looks to be in really good touch post the BPL. He gives away only a single off this over.
Edgy! Fuller and wide outside off, Rahmat throws his bat at it and edges it down to third man for a run.

Top effort in the field! A full-length ball, on off. Shah gets it towards mid-wicket off the inner half. Ibrahim Zadran wants a single and steps out as well but is sent back as Liton Das attacks the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end. Misses.
A length ball, outside off, shaping across the right-hander. Shah leaves it alone for the keeper. This is really good bowling.

Half a chance! A length ball, pitching on middle and coming into the right-hander, angling down leg. Shah comes forward and looks to flick it away but misses to get pinged on the pads. Rahman appeals for lbw but the umpire is unmoved.
Rahman nails a yorker, in the blockhole. Shah hangs back and digs it out to the off side.
A length ball, on middle and leg. Shah shuffles across and flicks it through square leg for one run. Taskin Ahmed has given only 6 runs off his two overs so far.
Ahmed steams in and bangs it on a hard length, outside off. Shah leaves it alone for the keeper.
Back of a length, around off. Zadran guides it through backward point for a single.
Three dots in a row! A length ball, outside off, it shapes in off the deck. Ibrahim Zadran shoulders his arms at it. Ahmed is dictating terms with the ball by moving it both ways.
Touch short and on off. Zadran hangs back and blocks it out to safety.
Zadran does not get a hold of his shot! Full length, outside off. Zadran looks to go for a booming drive but gets an inside edge back to the bowler.
A length ball, angled into the off stump line. Shah stays inside the crease, opens the face of the bat late and taps it towards point. Just 2 runs and a wicket off it. A brilliant over by Rahman.
Full length, outside off. Shah leans in and drives it to covers with soft hands.
Sliding down the leg side, Ibrahim Zadran plays it off his pads and works it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Rahmat Shah walks in next at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mustafizur Rahman draws first blood. Rahmanullah Gurbaz departs for a timid score. This is the start the hosts were after. A full-length ball, on middle and off at 137.1 kph. Rahmanullah Gurbaz walks down the track, makes a little room and looks to go big across the line. But all he manages to do is hit it off the bottom half of the blade and skies it towards mid on. Tamim Iqbal keeps his eyes on the ball, moves a bit to his right and gathers it safely in the end.
Commentary.Howout: c Tamim Iqbal b Mustafizur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: Touch fuller, on middle and off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets behind the line and defends it back to the bowler with the full face of the blade.
A length ball, on the pads. Ibrahim Zadran flicks it to square leg for just one.
Length ball, outside off. Gurbaz shoulders arms to it. A tidy start by Taskin Ahmed.

UP AND OVER! Rahmanullah Gurbaz did not have much control of the shot this time. A length ball, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to go for the drive. It takes the outside half and flies over the man at backward point, who leaps but only manages to get fingertips on it. The fielder from third man runs to his right and keeps it down to just two.
A length ball, outside off. Gurbaz looks to defend it out but pulls his blade back in time.
This will keep the batsman guessing! A length ball, outside off, shaping in a little. Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to push it away but gets beaten on the inside edge.
Touch short and outside off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz comes forward and lets it go to the keeper. It is not close enough to trouble the batter.
Another wide! Good length, outside off, nipping away off the deck a long way. It flies outside the tramline and the umpire signals it as a wide.
Much better from Taskin Ahmed. Back of a length, outside off, it nips in a little bit. Rahmanullah Gurbaz shoulders arms at it.
WIDE! A length ball, wide outside off, it shapes away a long way. Mushfiqur Rahim dives to his right to collect the ball. Wide called by the umpire.
Taskin Ahmed to speed in with the second new ball.
Six runs off the first over. A decent start with the ball for Rahman. A length ball, on the pads. Gurbaz clips it to deep square leg for one.
Another dot ball! A good-length ball, angled across the right-hander. Gurbaz stays inside the crease and leaves it alone.
On a length, around middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays back and defends ahead of his front pad.
WIDE! This is a full ball, angled way across Gurbaz and going outside the tramline. Rahmanullah Gurbaz does not go after it. Wide called.
A length ball, outside off, Gurbaz does not go chasing away from his body.

FOUR! Straight down the ground! Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Afghanistan are off the mark. Touch fuller, on off. Gurbaz shows the full face of the blade and drives it down the ground past the bowler. It races away to the long off fence with the help of the fast outfield.
Rahman starts with a full-length ball, wide outside off but just inside the tramline. Rahmanullah Gurbaz leaves it alone for the keeper. It is a legal delivery.

Time to get going! The players are walking out to the middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Ibrahim Zadran are the openers for Afghanistan. It's going to be Mustafizur Rahman to kick off proceedings. One slip in place. Here we go...

Tamim Iqbal, the skipper of Bangladesh, says that he would have also batted first but it's a good wicket for batting and they won't mind chasing. Adds that ODI is one of their favourite formats, they are playing after some time and looking forward to it. Mentions that they will be looking to pick early wickets and see what happens. Informs that Yasir Ali is making his debut.

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the captain of Afghanistan, says that the surface looks good for batting and maybe there will be something for the bowlers initially. Tells that they have tried to put together the best squad and is looking forward to playing here. Mentions that every 10 points matter.

Pitch report - The surface has some live grass but it's all rolled in nicely and will be good for batting. The fast bowlers will get some movement with the new balls if they hit the right line and length. Chasing teams have won more often here in the recent past.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Ibrahim Zadran, Rahmat Shah, Hashmatullah Shahidi (C), Najibullah Zadran, Gulbadin Naib, Mohammad Nabi, Rashid Khan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Yamin Ahmadzai, Fazalhaq Farooqi.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Liton Das, Tamim Iqbal (C), Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Yasir Ali (On ODI Debut), Mahmudullah, Afif Hossain, Mehidy Hasan, Shoriful Islam, Taskin Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Afghanistan. They have elected to BAT first.

Strengths and weaknesses! If we throw a bit of light on this, Afghanistan's biggest strength is their spin department and their batting can be counted a bit light. That said, there are some quality batsmen in their ranks who will be looking to make an impression on this tour. For Bangladesh, you can say that they are a batting-heavy unit with plenty of experience and exposure in this format. They have always owned quality in their spin department as well but one thing that has been quickly changing is their pace battery. Now, the Bangla Tigers are building a good army of pace bowlers and the likes of Ebadot Hossain, Shoriful Islam, Taskin Ahmed and Mustafizur Rahman offer them great variety in bowling. We have not talked about any weaknesses for Bangladesh, as playing in the home conditions, they don't have any loopholes. Fatigue can be an issue as most of their players are coming after playing in the BPL but apart from that, we will get to know about their weaknesses as the series progresses.

The Zahur Ahmed Chowdhury Stadium in Chattogram is going to be the hub for the ODI series and Bangladesh have maintained an excellent record at this venue. They win more often than not at this place in the last ten years but given the conditions which will suit Afghanistan's style of playing as well, it's not straightforward to pick a favourite. The Afghans themselves have been in a roaring form and are on a 6-match winning streak and are the only team to not lose a single match in the World Cup Super League 2020-2022 points table (Minimum 5 matches). So it's going to be a clash of two in-form teams and we can only hope for a humdinger.

A warm welcome to everyone! It's time to start a fresh tour and two rising teams of Asia will be crossing swords for supremacy. Afghanistan have arrived in Bangladesh and have also avoided any COVID-19 hiccups that initially threatened as all their players are negative and raring to go. The rise of Afghanistan of late has been exceptional but in the Bangla Tigers, they will be facing a stern test. These three coming ODIs will hand them a fair idea about where they stand. Bangladesh have faced tough times of late but under Tamim Iqbal, they have started to respond. The same can be said for the Afghans who change captains at the drop of a hat but seem to be settling down well under the new leadership of Hashmatullah Shahidi. Let's hope to see some mouth-watering action.
